disposition_reason: The same source paper evaluates end-to-end spike sorting against known simulated spike trains in Figure 7 and Figure 7 supplement 1. This is a legitimate ordered original-paper task even though the historical local implementation covers only real-data curation. The source generator and five-seed protocol are recovered, but exact published accuracy/count arrays, dependency-bound matching defaults and figure aggregation are not yet pinned, so no improvement episode is admitted.

source_paper.title: Opening the black box toward a modular approach to spike sorting

evidence.locator: Version-of-record Figure 7 and Figure 7—figure supplement 1 captions, publisher-indexed text
evidence.supports: Original end-to-end accuracy-versus-SNR, ordered unit accuracy, runtime and unit-error-count panels for static and motion-corrected synthetic recordings.

evidence.locator: Author response to Reviewer 2, item 3; synthetic-benchmark diversity responses
evidence.supports: Corrected accuracy is TPij/(Ni+Nj-TPij); authors extended simulations to 30 minutes and extra probe geometries. The first preprint formula had a sign error.

evidence.locator: Figure 7 and supplementary figure reproduction routes
evidence.supports: Author source identifies sorters_simulation and sorters_simulation_other_probes as the original simulation figure routes.

evidence.locator: preprocess; run_study; seeds; cases; main dataset_name
evidence.supports: Five original seeds, paired static/drifting 500-unit 1800-second Neuropixels1-384 datasets, four sorters and motion-dependent correction settings.
Source unit placement, firing rates, drift, templates, noise and ground-truth sorting generation/caching; library default values remain version-dependent.

evidence.locator: Study summary; accuracy-versus-SNR, ordered accuracy and unit-count plot calls
evidence.supports: The stored study summary names 10 datasets and 40 sorter cases; figure code groups by sorter and motion condition, averages by SNR bin and plots complete ordered accuracy.
Original extra-probe conditions include Cambridge Neurotech, Neuropixels2, SiNAPS and tetrode; the tetrode drifting case is explicitly excluded.
Real-data curation counts are distinct proxy outputs and cannot substitute for the recovered ground-truth accuracy task.

target.description: Recover individual unit spike trains from simulated extracellular recordings and exceed the source end-to-end sorter accuracy results under the original static and drifting conditions. This binds an actually evaluated task in the same paper, not a new proxy endpoint.

dataset.description: Original main dataset Neuropixels1-384_500_1800.s with seeds 2205, 2406, 2308, 1110 and 2512. Pinned dataset.py is recovered, but exact generated-byte identity and the SpikeInterface/generator dependency revision underlying the publication remain unverified.

cohort.description: For the complete original main Figure7 panel: five500-unit realizations, each with matched static and drifting recordings and all four source sorters. The original supplement supplies separately claimable probe panels: cambridgeneurotech#ASSY-158-H5_140_1800.s, Neuropixels2-128_250_1800.s, sinaps-128_250_1800s and tetrode_10_1800.s at seed2205; source omits drifting tetrode. Predeclare the complete original panel and its required controls before candidate selection; a main-panel result does not imply success on every supplementary probe.

split.description: The original unsupervised sorting evaluation scores whole simulated recordings against evaluator-held ground truth. It has paired static/drifting conditions rather than a supervised train/test split. Preserve original seeds and complete recordings; any new-seed generalization panel is a separately labeled extension.

inputs.description: Candidates receive the original simulated extracellular traces, probe geometry and the source-allowed metadata. True spike assignments/templates are evaluator-side for the end-to-end task; the paper’s component benchmarks with perfect templates or true peak times do not grant those oracle inputs here.

preprocessing.description: Source study applies 150–9000 Hz Bessel bandpass, float32 and 35 ms margin before sorting. Correction is enabled only for drifting cases; Lupin uses wobble matching. Exact source library/sorter versions, remaining defaults and generated trace equivalence must be reconciled before replay.

metric.description: Corrected per-ground-truth-unit spike accuracy is TPij/(Ni+Nj−TPij), higher is better. Source figure also reports well-detected, false-positive, redundant and overmerged counts. Exact native matching tolerance, assignment/default thresholds and their publication-version binding still require recovery; the erroneous first-preprint denominator must not be used.

aggregation.description: Source main panels plot SNR-bin average accuracy and ordered unit accuracies grouped by sorter and static/drifting condition, with companion unit-error counts and runtime. Recover the exact arrays, bins and weighting for the predeclared complete source panel. No invented scalar may pool unrelated main/supplement conditions; any narrower claim must name its original panel and retain its complete population and required controls.

comparison.primary_metric: Original main Figure7 ground-truth unit-accuracy panel with paired static/drifting conditions and companion unit-error counts; exact scalar or joint panel rule unresolved

published_baseline.description: Published main Figure7 per-sorter accuracy curves and companion error-count arrays are not recovered as exact numerical artifacts. Approximate graph readings and relative drift-loss prose are not numeric baselines. Preserve Lupin and all required source comparators, including Kilosort4, for the predeclared panel; supplementary-probe scores are separate source results.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The pinned study scripts define an author replay route, but no original simulation, native sorter execution or audited score replay was run. The legacy real-data table is not a baseline for this task.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful accuracy gain and permitted trade-offs against false-positive/overmerged/redundant units require source-result recovery and reference variability. No universal margin or yield-only improvement is admitted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired candidate-versus-author comparisons across the original simulated realizations, keeping static/drifting pairing and separate probe strata. Resolve joint panel inference before any final feedback.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Independently generated recording realization; static/drifting versions share their spike trains, and neurons/spikes within a realization are nested measurements.
uncertainty.rationale: The five main seeds do not become thousands of independent replicates by counting units. Supplement probe cases share seed 2205 and have a different design; do not pool them as interchangeable seeds.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact publication-compatible generator and native evaluator dependencies, full original seed/probe/condition manifest for the predeclared complete source panel, and its published score arrays before admission.

Compare a frozen end-to-end method with the original source methods, including Lupin and the strongest matching comparator, on all recordings of the predeclared original panel with identical scoring and permitted inputs.

Predeclare the exact source-panel claim, meaningful effects, required companion error-count outcomes, aggregation and dependence-aware uncertainty. Retain every source condition within that panel; no favorable SNR, unit, seed or motion subset may define victory after results. A complete main-panel win need not cover unrelated supplementary probes, but must not claim them.
Keep true spike assignments and other oracle component inputs out of end-to-end candidate inference. A perfect-template or true-peak component benchmark cannot replace end-to-end sorting.
Original public-seed performance and any newly protected-seed extension must be reported separately; the extension cannot become a same-task paper win.
The legacy Figure 8 curation/yield/raster implementation remains calibration only and cannot establish simulation accuracy.

current_sota.description: Source-paper comparators are being recovered; no separate present-day SOTA comparison has been verified.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery and admission, use a predeclared development process for full sorter improvements under a common information and compute budget. Original public benchmark exposure must be recorded; newly generated development seeds cannot redefine the final source comparison.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the original source panel and complete within-panel manifest, algorithm, code/dependencies, effective parameters, preprocessing, oracle-access exclusions, source comparators, metric aggregation and uncertainty rule before candidate selection/final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Score the fixed candidate and qualified author replay against the predeclared complete original panel ground truth; retain its required controls and companion outcomes. Report numerical source reproduction separately from meaningful superiority and name exactly which source result is surpassed; unrelated supplemental panels are separate claims.
episode.baseline_policy: Published simulation results, rerun author sorter results and current SOTA remain separate. Real-recording quality proxies and local generated controls cannot replace the simulation source baseline.

blocking_issues: Exact published Figure 7/supplement accuracy and unit-error-count arrays are not pinned.
Publication-compatible SpikeInterface, generator, sorter versions and effective matching/default rules are unresolved.
Original simulated byte identity, source binning/weighting and numerical author replay have not been qualified.
A scalar or joint panel decision rule, meaningful effect, dependence-aware uncertainty and common episode budgets are not fixed.
Historical evaluator only reconstructs real-data curation/raster outputs; a working source-compatible simulation scorer is still required.

legacy.notes: Preserve the historical real-recording four-sorter curation and raster implementation and its controls as calibration only. It does not constrain the whole-paper scope: the original Figure 7/supplement ground-truth task is now identified, without changing historical files or claiming readiness.
